title: The Distant Protocol
author: Wren Coldharbour
blurb: Wendell Coldharbour, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
